senses.gloss: m. (חד, with ר inserted; cmp. גַּד I) mustard.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:2">Kil. I, 2</cite> <he>ח׳ וח׳ המצרי</he> common mustard and Egyptian mustard.
<cite ref="Berakhot 40a:7">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>הרגיל בח׳ וכ׳</he> he who is used to take mustard once in &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 31a">Ib. 31ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כח׳</he> as large as a grain of mustard; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H01604"><he>חַרְדְּלִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="H01604"><he>חַרְדְּלִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11:1">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>כמה ח׳</he> ever so many grains of &c.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 25b:10">B. Bath. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>הרחק דבורך מן חַרְדְּלַיי</he> keep thy bee-hive from my mustard plants; <cite ref="Bava Batra 18a:15">ib. 18ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="H01604"><he>חַרְדְּלַאי</he></cite> (Ms. F. a. R. <cite ref="H01604"><he>חרדלַי</he></cite>).
